title: Activation Response
description: Response of POST /__remote_everything_activate: the request a paired device makes, for one node, to be admitted and told what that node runs. It is answered with the catalog of that node — the same body GET /__remote_everything/apps answers with — or with a refusal. HTTP 202 with code approval_pending is not a failure: the device paired and its operator has not confirmed it yet, and the client asks again.

allOf.description: Activation is answered with a catalog only after the node answered, so this is always the connected variant: a device is never activated against a node that is not there.
